query: Our district office needs 50 laptops for new staff. What should I prepare before choosing GeM or a tender?
reference_answer: Record the consolidated requirement and estimated cost, prepare neutral technical specifications, confirm budget and competent approval, then check whether the required laptops are available on GeM. If the applicable rules do not permit the selected GeM route or the item is unavailable, use the permitted tender route. Do not split the requirement merely to use a different method.
answer:
Answer
Before choosing GeM or a Tender, record the consolidated requirement and estimated cost, prepare neutral technical specifications, confirm budget availability and competent approval, and retain the supporting procurement documents. Then check whether the requirement is available on GeM and whether the applicable Chhattisgarh rules permit the selected GeM route; otherwise use the permitted Tender route. Do not split the requirement merely to use a different method.

📘 Source: Manual for Procurement of Goods 2024

query: Department ko 100 chairs chahiye. Kya direct purchase ho sakti hai ya tender karna padega?
reference_answer: Pehle estimated value, specifications aur GeM availability check karein. Direct purchase, limited tender ya open tender sirf current Chhattisgarh rules, delegated powers aur approval ke mutabik choose karein. Requirement ko split karke doosra method use na karein.
answer:
Answer
GeM availability ko automatic direct-purchase authority na samjhein. Pehle consolidated estimated value, approved specifications, GeM availability, current Chhattisgarh rule/delegated powers aur required approval confirm karein. Direct purchase, permitted GeM method, Limited Tender ya Open Tender sirf applicable rule allow kare tabhi choose karein. Route badalne ke liye requirement split na karein.

📘 Source: Chhattisgarh Store Purchase Rules

query: Can I write Dell-only in the laptop specification because our team already uses Dell?
expected_source_documents: Compilation of CVC Circulars and Guidelines.pdf
reference_answer: Normally use generic, functional and measurable specifications rather than a brand-only requirement. A brand or model restriction should be used only where a genuine technical or compatibility necessity is recorded in writing and the applicable rules allow it; include an equivalent provision where appropriate.
retrieved_sources_top10: Compilation of CVC Circulars and Guidelines.pdf
final_sources: Compilation of CVC Circulars and Guidelines.pdf

matched_expected_sources: compilation of cvc circulars and guidelines.pdf
compilation of cvc circulars and guidelines.pdf

answer:
Answer
Normally, do not write a Dell-only specification merely because the team already uses Dell. Use neutral, functional and measurable requirements. A brand restriction is appropriate only where a genuine compatibility or technical necessity is recorded in writing, permitted by the applicable rule, and an equivalent option is included where appropriate.

📘 Source: Manual for Procurement of Goods 2024; Compilation of CVC Circulars and Guidelines

query: Office ke AC ka AMC renew karna hai. Tender se pehle scope mein kya kya likhna chahiye?
reference_answer: AMC scope mein covered AC units and sites, service frequency, response time, uptime or SLA, spares coverage, exclusions, penalty terms, contract period and payment milestones define karein. Estimated value and approvals record karke permitted procurement method choose karein.
answer:
Answer
AC AMC scope mein covered AC units/sites, service frequency, response time aur uptime/SLA, preventive aur breakdown maintenance, spares coverage/exclusions, escalation process, applicable penalty/service-credit conditions, contract period, acceptance records aur payment milestones define karein. Estimated value aur approvals record karke applicable rules ke under permitted procurement route choose karein.

📘 Source: Manual for Procurement of Goods 2024

query: Flooding damaged our office network equipment. Can we buy replacements immediately?
reference_answer: Emergency procurement may be used only as an exceptional response to the urgent situation. Record the facts and reasons, obtain competent-authority approval, purchase only what is necessary, and follow the applicable Chhattisgarh rules. It is not an unrestricted direct-purchase route.
answer:
Answer
Emergency procurement may be used only as an exceptional response to the urgent situation. Record the facts and reasons, obtain competent-authority approval, buy only what is necessary, and follow the applicable Chhattisgarh rules. It is not an unrestricted direct-purchase route.

📘 Source: Manual for Procurement of Goods 2024; Public Procurement Manual

query: I have never used the Chhattisgarh e-procurement portal. How do I become a registered bidder?
reference_answer: Open the Chhattisgarh e-procurement portal, choose New User under registration, enter the required PAN and organisation details, upload the required information, select or map the appropriate DSC, accept the terms and conditions, and retain the generated registration number. Follow the current portal instructions for fees and approval.
answer:
Answer
Open the e-Procurement portal and choose New User or the Vendor Registration option. Enter the required PAN and organisation details, upload the required documents, select or map the valid DSC where the portal asks for it, accept the applicable declaration, and submit the registration. Retain the generated registration number and verify the registration or approval status in the portal. Follow the current portal notice for any fee or further approval requirement; do not assume a fixed fee.

📘 Source: Vendor Registration Manual (CHiPS)

query: Mera DSC renew ho gaya hai, ab portal par purana certificate kaise replace karun?
reference_answer: Apne vendor account mein login karke DSC selection or mapping screen par renewed DSC select karein, required confirmation complete karein, aur portal status verify karein. Valid signing/encryption DSC use karein; tender-specific signing steps alag ho sakte hain.
answer:
Answer
Vendor account mein login karke DSC selection/mapping option kholein. Renewed valid DSC connect karein, select karke required confirmation complete karein. Tender signing se pehle verify karein ki naya certificate mapped/active dikh raha hai. Renewed DSC detect na ho to portal helpdesk use karein.

📘 Source: Vendor Registration Manual (CHiPS)

query: My EMD payment failed, but the bank has debited the amount. What should I do before the bid deadline?
reference_answer: Do not assume that a bank debit means the EMD is successful. Check the portal payment status and transaction details, retain the bank and portal reference or receipt, and contact the portal/payment helpdesk promptly if the status remains unsuccessful. Complete a valid EMD payment before the bid deadline where the tender requires it.
answer:
💡 Answer
If an EMD/Bid Security eChallan payment failed after the amount was debited, and it is not credited to the beneficiary account by the Tender's Bid Due Date, the payment may be returned to the source account and the Bid may be treated as unpaid or rejected. Do not use a screenshot's amount or date; the specific Tender controls.

📋 Process
1. Check the transaction and EMD/Bid Security payment status in the relevant Tender.
2. Compare the credited amount and time with that Tender's current Bid Due Date.
3. Do not re-use the same challan for another Tender.
4. If the status is not Successful or the credit has not reached the beneficiary, preserve the receipt/reference and use the Tender's official payment-support route before submitting a Bid.

📘 Source: EMD CHALLAN PAYMENT V1.0

query: Technical bid mein reject ho gaya hoon. Meri EMD refund kab aur kaise aayegi?
reference_answer: Unsuccessful bidder ki EMD refund department/tender owner opening and evaluation ke baad initiate karta hai, aur authorised department approver verification ke baad approve karta hai. System registered bank account ko refund instruction bhejta hai; bidder portal par refund status check kar sakta hai.
answer:
Answer
Applicable opening/evaluation stage ke baad Department Admin/Tender Owner eligible unsuccessful bidder ki EMD refund initiate karta hai. Department Approver verify aur approve karta hai; phir e-Procurement system registered bank account ke liye instruction bhejta hai. Completion ke liye portal status check karein. Fixed credit time promise na karein, kyunki approval aur bank processing vary karte hain.

📘 Source: EMD Refund Guidelines (CHiPS)

query: My technical documents are uploaded. Where do I enter the price bid and how do I know it was submitted?
reference_answer: Use the Financial Bid, Price Bid or BOQ part of the same tender, enter or upload the required price values, validate the figures, sign or encrypt using the valid DSC where required, save and submit before the deadline, and verify the final acknowledgement or status.
answer:
Answer
Open the same Tender's Financial Bid, Price Bid or BOQ section. Use the original portal-provided BOQ file where required, enter or upload the requested price values, validate the figures without changing protected formulas, and complete DSC signing/encryption where the Tender requires it. Save and submit before the deadline, then verify the final acknowledgement or submitted status in the portal.

📘 Source: Bid Submission Manual (CHiPS)

query: Bid submit kar di thi, lekin deadline ke baad rate galat dikha. Kya edit kar sakta hoon?
reference_answer: Nahi. Bid-submission deadline ke baad bid ko alter or modify nahi kiya ja sakta. Submitted acknowledgement preserve karein aur agar tender owner corrigendum or clarification issue kare to uske tender-specific instructions follow karein.
answer:
💡 Answer
Nahi. Bid-submission deadline ke baad bidder Bid ko alter ya modify nahi kar sakta. Submitted acknowledgement preserve karein aur tender-specific corrigendum/clarification instruction follow karein; pre-deadline edit ya withdrawal steps use na karein.

📘 Source: Bid Submission Manual (CHiPS)

query: Our startup wants to bid for a government tender. Does startup status automatically remove every eligibility and EMD condition?
reference_answer: No. A startup may participate if it meets the tender conditions. Any startup relaxation or preference must be expressly available under the applicable rule and tender; startup status does not automatically remove technical compliance, every eligibility condition, EMD, or submission requirements.
retrieved_sources_top10: FAQ of Chhattisgarh Infotech Promotion Society(CHIPS).pdf
answer:
Answer
Eligibility conditions must be stated in the tender, relevant to the requirement and applied equally. Turnover, experience, local support, MSME/startup benefits, land-border restrictions and document verification apply only to the scope and evidence specified by the applicable rule and tender. They are neither automatic waivers nor arbitrary restrictions. Do not relax a material criterion for one bidder after publication; if a permitted change is needed, issue a common corrigendum and allow adequate time where the change is material.

📘 Source: Manual for Procurement of Goods 2024

query: Hum foreign company hain. CG tender ke liye DSC aur registration ka practical process kya hoga?
reference_answer: Specific tender ki foreign-bidder conditions pehle check karein. DSC ke liye licensed Certificate Authority ka application process follow karein, required organisation and identity documents Indian Embassy se certify karayein where applicable, then CA instructions ke according documents/payment complete karke DSC or token obtain karein. Tender-specific eligibility and registration requirements still apply.
answer:
Answer
Pehle specific Tender mein foreign-bidder participation, eligibility, currency aur registration conditions check karein. DSC ke liye licensed Certificate Authority se application lein, required organisation/identity documents complete karein, applicable process mein Indian Embassy certification karayein, prescribed documents/payment CA ko submit karein aur DSC/e-token obtain karein. Tender ki eligibility aur registration conditions hi final control karengi.

📘 Source: Vendor Registration Manual (CHiPS)

query: I have been invited to a forward e-auction. What should I check before placing a bid?
reference_answer: Log in with the bidder credentials and DSC, open the Auction tab, select the relevant auction and View/Respond to the RFX, review the opening price and minimum bid-change conditions, then place and submit bids only in accordance with those conditions.
answer:
Answer
Use your authorised bidder credentials and valid DSC, open the relevant Auction and choose View/Respond. Before bidding, review the auction terms, opening price and minimum bid-change condition. Enter a bid only within those conditions, submit it, and verify the displayed acknowledgement or current bid status. Do not rely on or disclose any default password.

📘 Source: AuctionManual FA

query: I am the department operator. What do I need ready before creating a tender in the portal?
reference_answer: Before creating the tender, ensure the approved requirement, estimate, procurement method, specifications, eligibility and evaluation conditions, tender schedule, supporting documents, and authorised department-user access are ready. Create only the approved procurement; bidders should not be given department-side workflow steps.
retrieved_sources_top10: Compilation of CVC Circulars and Guidelines.pdf
answer:
Answer
Before creating a Tender, keep the approved procurement inputs ready first. Prepare the approved requirement, estimated cost and competent approvals; finalise the technical specifications, bid parts, eligibility/document requirements and evaluation conditions; keep the NIT reference, tender call number, description, PAC if applicable, office/division, tender schedule and bid dates ready; keep the required attachments, bidder documents and payment/EMD details ready; and ensure an authorised department Tender Creator with the required DSC/workflow access will create the record. Then enter and save the Tender header and attachments in the authorised portal workflow, and verify the completed record before publication.

📘 Source: Offline Tender Upload Manual (CHiPS)

query: Tender publish ho chuka hai aur last date badhani hai. Corrigendum kaise issue karun?
reference_answer: Authorised department user relevant tender par date corrigendum create kare, revised deadline and related details verify kare, required approval/route complete kare, aur corrigendum publish kare. Published revised date bidders ko portal par visible honi chahiye.
answer:
Answer
Authorised department workflow se Date Corrigendum issue karein. Relevant tender kholkar Date Corrigendum option choose karein, revised bid date/time enter karke change save karein, required approval workflow complete karein, publish karein aur verify karein ki revised deadline bidders ko visible hai. Bid deletion ko general date-extension consequence na batayein; yeh corrigendum type par depend karta hai.

📘 Source: Corrigendum Issuance Manual (CHiPS)

query: The technical-bid opening time has arrived. As the bid opener, what is the safe portal workflow?
reference_answer: Use the authorised department account and the relevant tender after the scheduled opening time. Open the technical bid stage according to the portal and tender process, preserve the bid-opening record, and proceed with eligibility and technical evaluation under the published conditions. Do not disclose or open the price bid unless the applicable stage permits it.
answer:
Answer
After the scheduled opening time, use the authorised department account and open the relevant Tender's Technical Bid stage only. Preserve the bid-opening record and proceed with eligibility and technical evaluation under the published conditions. Do not open, disclose or evaluate the Price Bid until the applicable stage and Tender process permit it. Follow the authorised portal workflow rather than relying on assumed menu names.

📘 Source: Bid Submission Manual (CHiPS)

query: Unsuccessful bidders ka EMD refund department side se initiate kaise hota hai?
reference_answer: Tender owner or department admin unsuccessful bidders ke liye EMD remittance/refund process initiate karta hai after the applicable opening and evaluation stages. Department approver verification ke baad approval deta hai, aur system registered bidder bank accounts ko refund instruction bhejta hai.
answer:
Answer
Applicable opening/evaluation stage ke baad Department Admin/Tender Owner eligible unsuccessful bidder ki EMD refund initiate karta hai. Department Approver verify aur approve karta hai; phir e-Procurement system registered bank account ke liye instruction bhejta hai. Completion ke liye portal status check karein. Fixed credit time promise na karein, kyunki approval aur bank processing vary karte hain.

📘 Source: EMD Refund Guidelines (CHiPS)

query: I am new in the office: when should I think about GeM and when is the state e-procurement portal relevant?
reference_answer: GeM is the Government e-Marketplace channel used where the goods or services and the permitted purchase route are available there. The state e-procurement portal is used for portal-managed tender, bid and related processes. The department must select the route permitted by current Chhattisgarh rules and approvals.
answer:
Answer
GeM is a government marketplace and procurement channel for goods or services where the applicable rules permit its use. The State e-Procurement portal is used to publish and manage tender processes, including bid receipt, opening and corrigenda. First select the lawful procurement route under current Chhattisgarh rules and approvals, then use the appropriate channel. Do not apply generic monetary thresholds unless they are confirmed by the governing rule.

📘 Source: Manual for Procurement of Goods 2024

query: छत्तीसगढ़ में सरकारी खरीद के मुख्य तरीके कौन-कौन से हैं?
reference_answer: छत्तीसगढ़ में सरकारी खरीद के लिए लागू नियमों के अनुसार GeM अथवा राज्य ऑनलाइन पोर्टल, निविदा प्रक्रिया, दूसरे सरकारी विभाग या उपक्रम से खरीद, और आपदा या कानून-व्यवस्था जैसी असाधारण परिस्थितियों में अनुमत विशेष खरीद मार्ग हो सकते हैं। हर मार्ग पर लागू नियम, स्वीकृति और शर्तें लागू रहती हैं।
answer:
💡 उत्तर
छत्तीसगढ़ procurement में channels/platforms और procurement methods अलग हैं। GeM तथा State e-Procurement portal चुने गए मार्ग को चलाने के channel हैं; registration या login procurement method नहीं है।

📋 प्रमुख खरीद मार्ग
1. GeM procurement
2. Tender procurement — Open, Limited या Single Tender लागू शर्तों में।
3. अनुमत direct purchase — नियमों, मूल्य-शर्तों, प्रत्यायोजित शक्तियों और स्वीकृति के अनुसार।
4. अंतर-विभागीय/undertaking purchase — नियमों द्वारा अनुमत होने पर।
5. Emergency/special procurement — अपवादात्मक, दर्ज कारणों और सक्षम स्वीकृति के साथ।
6. Foreign/global purchase — केवल लागू GFR/rules और approvals द्वारा समर्थित होने पर।

पहले route चुनें, फिर उचित GeM या e-Procurement channel उपयोग करें। Registration, vendor login और DSC setup procurement methods नहीं हैं।

📘 स्रोत: Chhattisgarh Store Purchase Rules; Store Purhase Rules 28.01.2021
